subskills.archetype: Power of a Point (Intersecting Chords, Secants & Tangents) & Tangent-Radius Perpendicularity
subskills.aim: Apply Power of a Point theorems (PA·PB = PC·PD for chords and secants, PT^2 = PA·PB for tangent-secant) and the perpendicularity of a radius to a tangent line.

subskills.archetype: Completing the Square on Circle Equations & Tangent Line Equations
subskills.aim: Convert x^2 + y^2 + Dx + Ey + F = 0 to standard form (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 by completing the square, and find the equation of the line tangent to a circle at a given point.

subskills.archetype: Parallel & Perpendicular Line Equations and Perpendicular Bisectors
subskills.aim: Write equations of lines parallel or perpendicular to a given line through a specified point, including the perpendicular bisector of a segment.

subskills.archetype: Coordinate Polygon Area (Shoelace / Box Method), Perimeter & Classification
subskills.aim: Calculate the exact perimeter and area of triangles and quadrilaterals on the coordinate plane and prove whether a coordinate quadrilateral is a rectangle, rhombus, square, or trapezoid.

subskills.archetype: Point-to-Line Distance, Coordinate Triangle Centers & Focus-Directrix Parabolas
subskills.aim: Compute the shortest perpendicular distance from a point to a line, find coordinate orthocenters/circumcenters, and derive parabola equations from focus and directrix.

subskills.archetype: Segment Addition Postulate & Midpoint Formula
subskills.aim: Apply the Segment Addition Postulate, distance formula, and midpoint coordinates on the number line and coordinate plane.

subskills.archetype: Directed Segment Fractional Partitioning
subskills.aim: Find the coordinates of a point P that partitions a directed line segment AB in a given ratio m:n.

subskills.archetype: Deductive Logic: Converse, Inverse, Contrapositive & Counterexamples
subskills.aim: Evaluate truth values of conditional, converse, inverse, contrapositive, and biconditional geometric statements and construct counterexamples.

subskills.archetype: Complementary, Supplementary, Vertical & Linear Pair Angles
subskills.aim: Solve algebraic equations formed by vertical angles, linear pairs, complementary angles, and angle bisectors.

subskills.archetype: Parallel Lines Cut by a Transversal
subskills.aim: Apply corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and consecutive interior angle theorems to solve for unknown variables.

subskills.archetype: Auxiliary Parallel Lines & Crook-Angle Transversals
subskills.aim: Solve multi-transversal and bent/crook-angle problems between parallel lines by constructing an auxiliary parallel line.

subskills.archetype: Geometric Probability (Length/Area Ratios) & Addition Rule P(A U B)
subskills.aim: Compute geometric probabilities using ratios of segment lengths or shaded areas, and apply the Addition Rule P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B).

subskills.archetype: Conditional Probability P(A|B), Two-Way Tables & Independence Tests
subskills.aim: Calculate conditional probabilities from two-way frequency tables and Venn diagrams, and test whether two events A and B are statistically independent.

subskills.archetype: Permutations, Combinations & Multi-Stage Tree Diagram / Bayes Probability
subskills.aim: Solve compound probability problems without replacement using tree diagrams, combinations nCr, permutations nPr, and Bayes’ theorem.

subskills.archetype: Convex Polygon Interior (n-2)*180° & Exterior 360° Angle Sums
subskills.aim: Calculate interior and exterior angle sums and individual angle measures in regular and irregular convex n-gons.

subskills.archetype: Parallelogram, Rectangle, Rhombus, Square & Kite Diagonal/Angle Properties
subskills.aim: Apply opposite-side, opposite-angle, and diagonal bisection/perpendicularity/congruence properties of parallelograms, rectangles, rhombi, squares, and kites.

subskills.archetype: Trapezoid Midsegment Theorem & Diagonals of Isosceles Trapezoids
subskills.aim: Solve algebraic problems using the Trapezoid Midsegment Theorem, isosceles trapezoid base angles/diagonals, and quadrilateral classification on the coordinate plane.

subskills.archetype: Pythagorean Theorem, Converse Classification & 45-45-90 / 30-60-90 Triangles
subskills.aim: Solve for exact radical side lengths using the Pythagorean Theorem and special right triangles (45°-45°-90° and 30°-60°-90°), and classify triangles as acute, right, or obtuse using a^2 + b^2 vs. c^2.

subskills.archetype: Right-Triangle Trig Ratios, Cofunction Identity sin(x)=cos(90-x) & Elevation/Depression
subskills.aim: Apply sine, cosine, tangent, inverse trigonometric ratios, and the complementary cofunction identity sin(theta) = cos(90° - theta) to solve right-triangle and angle of elevation/depression problems.

subskills.archetype: Law of Sines, Law of Cosines, Area 1/2 ab sin(C) & Two-Station Sightlines
subskills.aim: Solve non-right triangles using the Law of Sines, Law of Cosines, and K = (1/2)ab sin(C), including two-observer elevation sightlines and navigation bearings.

subskills.archetype: Side-Splitter (Thales) Parallel Transversal & Off-Origin Dilations
subskills.aim: Perform coordinate dilations centered at (x0, y0) with scale factor k, and solve for unknown segment lengths in nested triangles with a line parallel to the base.

subskills.archetype: Bowtie/Hourglass Similarity, Indirect Shadow Measurement & Angle Bisector Theorem
subskills.aim: Solve proportions in bowtie/hourglass parallel-line triangles, indirect shadow/mirror height problems, and triangles divided by an interior angle bisector.

subskills.archetype: Right-Triangle Altitude Geometric Mean (h^2 = pq, a^2 = qc) & k^2 Area / k^3 Volume Scaling
subskills.aim: Apply the Right-Triangle Altitude Geometric Mean Theorems to find altitude and leg lengths, solve inverted overlapping similar triangles (SAS/AA), and relate scale factor k to perimeter (k), area (k^2), and volume (k^3) ratios.

subskills.archetype: Surface Area & Volume of Prisms, Cylinders, Pyramids, Cones & Spheres
subskills.aim: Calculate lateral area, total surface area, and volume of right prisms, cylinders, regular pyramids, cones (relating radius, height, and slant height l), and spheres.

subskills.archetype: 2D Plane Cross-Sections, Cavalieri’s Principle & Solids of Revolution
subskills.aim: Identify 2D cross-sections of 3D solids sliced by a plane, apply Cavalieri’s principle to oblique solids, and compute the volume generated by rotating a 2D polygon around an axis.

subskills.archetype: Composite Solids, Frustums, Liquid Displacement & Density Modeling
subskills.aim: Solve multi-step modeling problems involving composite 3D solids (e.g., cylinder topped by a hemisphere), frustums of cones/pyramids, water displacement, and mass/population density.

subskills.archetype: Coordinate Translation by Vector <a, b> & Pre-Image Recovery
subskills.aim: Translate points and polygons on the coordinate plane using vector notation <a, b> or coordinate rule (x, y) -> (x + a, y + b), and recover pre-image vertices from an image.

subskills.archetype: Reflections Across Lines (x = h, y = k, y = x, y = -x) & Rotations About (h, k)
subskills.aim: Compute exact image coordinates under reflections across horizontal, vertical, or diagonal lines and 90°/180°/270° rotations about the origin or an arbitrary center (h, k).

subskills.archetype: Compositions of Rigid Motions, Glide Reflections & Polygon Symmetry Mapping
subskills.aim: Determine single transformations equivalent to compositions of reflections/translations, and find the exact lines of reflectional symmetry and angles of rotational symmetry that carry a polygon onto itself.

subskills.archetype: Triangle Angle-Sum, Exterior Angle & Isosceles Base Angles
subskills.aim: Apply the Triangle Angle-Sum Theorem, Exterior Angle Theorem, and Isosceles/Equilateral Triangle Theorems to find unknown interior and exterior angle measures.

subskills.archetype: Triangle Congruence Proofs (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL vs. SSA)
subskills.aim: Identify valid congruence criteria (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL), recognize why SSA and AAA fail, and determine the exact missing condition needed to prove two triangles congruent.

subskills.archetype: Triangle Centers (Centroid 2:1 Ratio, Circumcenter, Incenter) & Triangle Inequalities
subskills.aim: Apply the 2:1 centroid median division property, circumcenter/incenter equidistance theorems, Triangle Inequality Theorem, and Hinge Theorem.
